digest.component_or_area: rebar-debug skill and bug tracking workflow
propositions: rebar-debug skill closes bug tickets without recording the originating ticket that introduced the defect, preventing measurement of defect escape rate
The fallback blame derivation attributes defects to the author of most lines in affected files rather than to the commit that introduced the actual defect
The blame fallback cannot detect unmet-obligation defects where a producer change creates an obligation and a consumer is never updated, because it only examines paths touched by the fix

Skill documentation must add a required attribution step before bug close that identifies the originating ticket via blame and commit history analysis, with four possible resolutions: regression, unmet obligation, omission, or unattributable

The --caused-by flag must be supplied on bug close even when the caused_by link was already recorded earlier via rebar link, because _apply_caused_by unconditionally calls derive_caused_by when the flag is empty and creates a spurious second edge

Both rebar-debug and rebar-implement skills must bootstrap worktrees using make worktree name=<branch> instead of bare git worktree add to ensure the venv is provisioned and available on PATH for pre-commit hooks
